slug: 2025-07-07 Madagascar codifies civil registry reform, readies biometric ID card tender

systems.system: national biometric ID card production system
systems.platform: Laxton biometric registration kits; IN Groupe contract to modernise the civil registry and create a digital ID system
systems.owner: Government of Madagascar under PRODIGY (about $143 million from the World Bank)
systems.tiers: tender for large-scale card printing imminent in July 2025, after a market-engagement event on 11 June 2025
IN Groupe is said to hold a contract to modernise the civil registry; what the system does is not described

note: Reports Senate approval on 4 July 2025 of the bill on identification of natural persons, said also to overhaul the civil registration mechanism; no civil registration system is described.
